stx-rp-marketing-fixes.purpose: Read a local business site as a stranger: status per criterion (pass, partial, missing), contradictions vs its own brief, ranked fixes, fix prompts, exemplar URLs.

stx-rp-social-health.purpose: Score each public social account of a local business out of 10 from facts, set its level (Newcomer, Regular, Trusted, Insider), and list small fixes for bio, pinned post, replies.

stx-rp-tech-seo-geo.purpose: Crawl a local business site and score technical SEO and GEO on four pillars (crawlability, page clarity, quotability, authorship, 25% each) with ranked fixes per page.

stx-te-brief.purpose: Write the teaser brief for one prospect: named buyer, one undeniable sourced fact, four leaks (one revealed), industry exemplar, or a SKIP with reason.

stx-te-build.purpose: Build the teaser in the multi-teaser scaffold: teaser_content to content/<slug>.ts, register the slug, brand tokens, intel fetch via lib/intel/build.mjs, npm run build.

stx-te-copy.purpose: Write teaser section copy in the canonical order: finding-led headlines, about 90 words per section, free assessment in hero, wall and rail, prices only after the free rung.

stx-te-gate.purpose: Gate a built teaser: score axes to 8.0, the 8-item mirror checklist, template section 6 checklist, legal guard, CWV budget, Jev image and an eye check on desktop and mobile.

stx-te-mirror.purpose: Mirror the prospect in the teaser: map brand tokens to schema roles and globals.css, inherit their canvas mode, build ClientVoice and LivedLeak from real sourced facts.

stx-te-publish-dormant.purpose: Finish a gated teaser dormant: write the proof line, stage it for Mike's approval, and deploy a noindex preview only after his yes to the exact URL and message.

stx-te-visuals.purpose: Teaser visuals: 2 to 3 original images in the firm's exact hex via the Higgsfield MCP, confirm-first because credits cost money, or a free CSS/SVG motif fallback.

stx-teaser-os.purpose: Design and build a website teaser for one prospect: brief, brand mirror, copy, visuals, multi-teaser build, gate 8.0 plus 8/8 checklist, dormant handoff. Routes only.

mindmap-studio.purpose: K-Plex style mind maps on the Work Canvas: brainstorm, find patterns, spark and score new ideas with Creative Booster and Deviatrix

mm-seed.purpose: Mind map step 1: set the center question and first branches from Mike's existing boards, memory and files, never a blank page.

mm-branch.purpose: Mind map step 2: unfold one generation at a time, give every node a K-Plex role, and ask the Idea Compass questions.

mm-patterns.purpose: Mind map step 3: find patterns across branches (repeats, tensions, gaps) and add them as pattern hubs on the board.

mm-spark.purpose: Mind map step 4: generate new ideas from branch collisions and Creative Booster SCAMPER, Synectics and Oblique prompts.

mm-judge.purpose: Mind map step 5: score ideas with Creative Booster, check math with Deviatrix SymPy, add the strongest Challenger, write the shortlist.

mm-board.purpose: Mind map board ops: build, diff, verify and relayout a map on the Work Canvas, capture it in both themes, export to K-Plex.

stx-a11y-os.purpose: Accessibility and data compliance for a local business site: WCAG 2.2 AA scans, contrast, keyboard, screen reader, forms, media, privacy, cookies, TCPA and HIPAA intake.

stx-analytics-os.purpose: Install and read a local business's analytics: GA4 and GTM, lead events, call tracking, short links, funnels, flow maps, daily summary and fixes that stay open.

stx-cmo-os.purpose: AI CMO for a client site (HeyCatch AI CMO port): 30-day roadmap, daily task plan, ask-the-CMO answers with numbers, weekly review, graded predictions, monthly report.

stx-content-os.purpose: Content for a local business site: Google keyword map, question topics, articles with five takeaways, local pages, library-wide checks, calendar, refresh, Spanish.

stx-copy-os.purpose: Website copy for a local business: customer-words mining from reviews, hero, service pages, about and team, FAQ, buttons and microcopy, proof copy, voice and claims lint.

stx-cro-os.purpose: Conversion work on a local business site: evidence-based hypotheses, briefs, honest A/B tests, speed to lead, call handling, form analytics, offer tests, readouts.

stx-dev-os.purpose: Website development for local business sites: stack choice, staging, theme build, CMS model, forms and integrations, content migration, code review, owner handoff.

stx-discovery-os.purpose: Client discovery after a booked assessment or a yes: kickoff, goals and KPIs, owner interview, access inventory, constraints, scope, SOW draft, onboarding.

stx-geo-os.purpose: Get a local business named and quoted by AI assistants: baseline runs, entity consistency, quotable passages, llms.txt, authorship, AI-crawler access, tracking over time.

stx-ia-os.purpose: Information architecture for a local business site: page inventory, sitemap, service x city matrix, URLs, navigation, user flows, content matrix, internal links.

stx-launch-os.purpose: Launch and care for a client site: preflight, DNS and SSL with rollback, migration redirects, go-live run of show, 48-hour and 14-day watch, care plan, monthly report, renewal.

stx-local-os.purpose: Local search work for a client who said yes: Google Business Profile audit and edits, citations and NAP, reviews program, approved replies, rank grid, area pages, local links.

stx-media-os.purpose: Photos, video and media for a client site and socials: shot list, media library, AI imagery, image pipeline, short video, slideshows, video on site, rights log.

stx-perf-os.purpose: Site speed for local business sites: Core Web Vitals baseline, images, fonts, JS and third-party budget, critical CSS, caching and CDN, weekly vitals monitoring.

stx-seo-os.purpose: Implement technical and on-page SEO for a client site: crawl fixes, titles, schema, sitemaps, robots, redirects, internal links, Search Console, fixes ranked by points.

stx-social-os.purpose: Social work for a client who said yes: account health and levels, profile fixes, local rooms and keywords, catches, replies and posts in voice, timing, approved publishing.

stx-strategy-os.purpose: Business strategy for a site project (HeyCatch Foundation port): product brief, audience, competitors, positioning, messaging house, offer, voice, growth plan.

stx-system-os.purpose: Web design system for a client rebuild: tokens, type scale, spacing grid, components, section library, states and a11y, docs, and code parity against the built site.

stx-ux-os.purpose: UX for a local business site: visitor journeys, wireframes, first-screen test, lead forms, mobile and sticky call bar, trust placement, heuristic review, usability test.

stx-visual-os.purpose: Visual design for a client or prospect site: brand audit, identity refresh, palette and type, imagery direction, moodboards, 2-3 concepts, hi-fi mockups, critique.

stx-di-kickoff.purpose: Prep and run the discovery or kickoff call: one-page prep from the dossier, a timed agenda, quoted notes and the open questions filed back to the dossier.

stx-di-goals-kpis.purpose: Turn what the owner wants into three goals, each with one KPI, a measured baseline, the source it is read from and a review date. No targets invented.

stx-di-stakeholder-interview.purpose: Owner and front-desk interview script for a local service business: how leads arrive, who answers, what customers ask, what wins jobs. Answers stored as quotes.

stx-di-access-inventory.purpose: List every account the work needs (domain, host, CMS, GBP, analytics, Search Console, socials, forms, call tracking), its owner, and how the owner grants access by invite.

stx-di-constraints.purpose: Write the project limits before scope: budget band, dates, legal and licensing rules, brand rules, tech lock-ins, people and approval limits, each sourced.

stx-di-scope-proposal.purpose: Draft the scope and proposal from the audit, goals and constraints: what is in, what is out, phases, deliverables, the offer rung. A draft Mike approves.

stx-di-sow-contract.purpose: Turn the approved proposal into an SOW draft: deliverables, acceptance tests, timeline, change process, ownership and access hand-back. Mike approves; no legal advice.

stx-di-onboarding-checklist.purpose: Dependency-ordered onboarding list after the SOW is signed: access granted, measurement first, assets collected, approvals named. Nothing is built until it is green.

stx-sg-product-brief.purpose: Write the business brief everything else is built on: services, prices, proof, who it is for (three reads), trust gaps, tone, language. Quotes first, assumptions labeled.

stx-sg-audience-research.purpose: Score buyer segments for a local business, detail the top three (jobs, pains as quotes, triggers, vocabulary, where they ask), name segments to drop and anti-patterns.

stx-sg-competitor-research.purpose: Local competitor research: verdict on every rival (cut ones with the reason), two deep dives, a quoted matrix, better and worse columns, where to win and counter-positions.

stx-sg-positioning.purpose: Write one positioning statement for a local business (who, which job, which area, why them over named rivals) with the proof that earns each part, tested against the brief.

stx-sg-messaging-house.purpose: Build the messaging house: roof line, three pillars, proof under each pillar, objection answers and the words to use. Every page's copy is written from it.

stx-sg-offer-design.purpose: Design the first-step offer the site sells (free estimate, inspection, consult, same-day visit): what it includes, who qualifies, risk reversal, matched to PPC.io winners.

stx-sg-voice-never-say.purpose: Write the voice rules every output is held to: tone description, language and locale, do and don't rules, and a never-say list of up to twenty phrases.

stx-sg-growth-plan.purpose: Growth plan for a local business site: named plays that cite their evidence, scripted steps, quick wins first, a metric and window per play, effort in hours.

stx-ia-page-inventory.purpose: Inventory every page on the current site and give each a verdict (keep, merge, rewrite, retire, new) with evidence, before any new sitemap is drawn.

stx-ia-sitemap.purpose: Draw the target sitemap for a local service business: page tree, money pages within three clicks, one page per real service, hubs, and what each page is for.

stx-ia-service-location-matrix.purpose: Service by city matrix for local SEO without doorway pages: decide which service, city and service-in-city pages to build, each backed by real local facts.

stx-ia-url-plan.purpose: Plan URLs and canonicals for the new site and map every old URL to a new one with 301s, so a rebuild keeps the search traffic and links the old site earned.

stx-ia-navigation.purpose: Header, mobile menu and footer for a local service site: short top nav, phone and estimate button always visible, services menu, footer with name, address, phone, hours.

stx-ia-user-flows.purpose: Map how each kind of visitor (emergency, planned project, price shopper, existing customer, job seeker) gets from landing page to a call, form or booking, and count the steps.

stx-ia-content-matrix.purpose: One row per planned page: job, target search, primary CTA, section list, proof needed, owner-supplied inputs, status. The working sheet copy, content and design all read.

stx-ia-internal-links.purpose: Internal link rules for the whole site: hubs to services, services to cities and contact, descriptive anchors, and a site-wide check for orphan pages and dead links.

stx-ux-journeys.purpose: Visitor journeys for a local service site: trigger, device, the questions asked in order, where the site answers each, and the moment people get stuck.

stx-ux-wireframes.purpose: Grayscale wireframes for each page template (home, service, city, about, contact, landing) as simple HTML, each section labeled with its job and the content it needs.

stx-ux-first-screen.purpose: Five-second test of the first screen on desktop and phone: what is offered, where, for whom, how to act, why trust it. Scored per criterion with screenshots as evidence.

stx-ux-forms.purpose: Lead form design for local service sites: message box, fewest fields, visible labels, plain errors, a success state that says what happens next and when, no CAPTCHA wall.

stx-ux-mobile.purpose: Mobile UX for local service sites: sticky call and estimate bar, tap targets, thumb reach, readable type, tap-to-call and directions, and no popup that blocks the page.

stx-ux-trust-placement.purpose: Put proof where the decision happens: named reviews near the CTA, licenses and insurance, guarantees, financing, real team and job photos. Places only proof the business has.

stx-ux-heuristic-review.purpose: Heuristic UX review of mockups or staging: Nielsen's ten heuristics plus local-service checks, each issue rated on the 0 to 4 severity scale with a screenshot and fix.

stx-ux-usability-test.purpose: Five-person task test on staging before launch: realistic local tasks, success and time per task, verbatim notes, consent, and findings ranked by severity.

stx-vi-brand-audit.purpose: Audit a business's current brand across site pages, Google profile and socials: logo versions, color and type consistency, imagery, pass/partial/fail with evidence.

stx-vi-identity-refresh.purpose: Decide keep, refresh or rebrand for a local business identity; clean the logo into vector lockups, favicon and avatars, with the owner's written OK before anything goes live.

stx-vi-palette-type.purpose: Set a site's color roles and type pairing from the real brand: one leading hue, every text pair proven with contrast_ratio, one CTA color, licensed web fonts only.

stx-vi-imagery-direction.purpose: Write a site's imagery rules: real team and job photos first, licensed stock only as background, illustration and icon style, where AI images may appear, per page slot.

stx-vi-moodboard.purpose: Build one cited moodboard per design direction from industry exemplars, award-site references and the client's own assets. References only; nothing is copied.

stx-vi-concepts.purpose: Design 2-3 structurally distinct first-screen directions in the client's brand, each tied to the audit's lead fix and a pattern-map mechanism, at desktop and mobile.

stx-vi-hifi-mockups.purpose: High-fidelity mockups of the chosen direction for home, service, service-area, contact and about templates at desktop and mobile, with real copy and rights-cleared images.

stx-vi-design-critique.purpose: Critique concepts and mockups against the PPC.io pattern map and pre-flight list, anti-slop rules, contrast and hosted Jev image; ranked fixes and a diff on each re-run.

stx-ds-tokens.purpose: Write design tokens in three layers (primitive, semantic, component) as DTCG JSON and CSS custom properties, every color traced to its brand source and contrast-checked.

stx-ds-type-scale.purpose: Set a fluid type scale with clamp() between mobile and desktop widths, line heights and roles for headings, body and UI; body 16px or more on mobile; weights to perf.

stx-ds-spacing-grid.purpose: Set the spacing scale, breakpoints, layout columns, container widths and section rhythm as tokens, then check mockups against a grid overlay so pages line up.

stx-ds-components.purpose: Specify and build the components a local service site needs: header with click-to-call, sticky call bar, hero, service card, reviews, trust row, estimate form, FAQ, map, footer.

stx-ds-section-library.purpose: Compose components into reusable page sections per vertical (hero, proof, services, process, areas, FAQ, CTA), each tied to a pattern-map mechanism and a template slot.

stx-ds-states-a11y.purpose: Define every interactive state (hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error, success, empty) with visible focus, target sizes and reduced-motion rules.

stx-ds-docs.purpose: Publish the design system as a living styleguide page plus a one-page owner guide: tokens, components with do and don't, section orders, image rules, change log.

stx-ds-code-parity.purpose: Check the built site against the design system: computed colors, fonts, sizes and spacing vs tokens; rank drift; re-run after fixes until high drift is zero.

stx-cp-voc-mining.purpose: Mine voice of customer for a local business from public Google and Yelp reviews, competitor reviews and the owner: triggers, fears, praise, exact words, each with its source.

stx-cp-hero.purpose: Write the hero for each template: headline with service, place and outcome in customer words, subhead with proof or offer, one primary button, the phone, a trust line.

stx-cp-service-pages.purpose: Write one page per real service from its own facts: the problem, what the crew does, steps, price or estimate approach, proof for that service, FAQ, area served, next step.

stx-cp-about-team.purpose: About and team copy for a local business: owner story in their words, the real team, licenses and insurance, community ties, and author bios that make the site quotable.

stx-cp-faq-objections.purpose: FAQ and objection copy: the questions buyers ask before they call, in their words, each answered in the first sentence, placed beside the decision, and marked up for schema.

stx-cp-ctas-microcopy.purpose: Buttons and microcopy: CTA labels that name the next step, form labels, error and success messages, response-time and hours lines, phone link text, empty and 404 states.

stx-cp-proof-copy.purpose: Proof copy rules and drafts: review quotes with name, source and date, numbers only with a source, job stories with permission, and the line between a claim and a fact.

stx-cp-voice-lint.purpose: Voice rules and lint for all site copy: do and don't lists, never-say phrases, banned words, unsourced claims, contradictions across pages, phone and hours consistency.

stx-ct-keyword-map.purpose: Map the Google search terms a local business should win (service, city, emergency, cost) to exactly one target URL each, with the source for every term.

stx-ct-topic-plan.purpose: Plan article topics from questions buyers really ask (People also ask, GBP Q&A, reviews, call reasons), each citing its source, with effort in hours and a metric.

stx-ct-article.purpose: Draft one article for a local business: question title, five takeaways, table of contents, question headings with direct answers, sourced local facts, never-use check.

stx-ct-local-pages.purpose: Write service-area and city pages that carry real local substance (jobs, team, area notes, sourced local facts) so each page earns its place and none is a doorway page.

stx-ct-library-checks.purpose: Check the whole content library at once: repeated phrases, identical structure, same endings, one-shape headings, near-duplicate city pages, cannibalization, orphans.

stx-ct-calendar-publish.purpose: Content calendar for a client: schedule drafts, get the client's approval per piece, publish or hand off the formatted copy, log posted-with-date, archive unused drafts.

stx-ct-refresh.purpose: Refresh published content: find pieces with outdated facts, broken links, falling Search Console clicks or library-check failures; update in place with an honest date.

stx-ct-languages.purpose: Spanish (or another language) pages for a Denver business that truly serves those buyers: researched and written in the language, hreflang, native review, honest CTAs.

stx-md-shot-list.purpose: Plan a real photo and video shoot for a local business: owner, team, trucks, shop, work in progress, finished jobs; a phone shoot guide, consent and privacy rules.

stx-md-media-library.purpose: Run a client's media library: owner uploads and licensed stock in one grid, per-file categories for where each may appear, and a footage mix from stock-only to own-only.

stx-md-ai-imagery.purpose: Make AI images only for allowed abstract slots (backgrounds, textures, diagrams, concept art) via Higgsfield or Maestro, confirm-first, labeled, never real people or jobs.

stx-md-image-pipeline.purpose: Prepare every site image: crop to slot ratios, resize to responsive widths, WebP or AVIF, strip GPS metadata, set width and height, write alt text from what it shows.

stx-md-short-video.purpose: Daily deck of short vertical videos for a client's socials from its own footage: skip, edit or approve each idea, captions per platform, client approves, social lane posts.

stx-md-slideshows.purpose: Build vertical slideshows and carousels from real job photos: before and after, process steps, FAQ answers, review highlights; text-safe frames, captions per platform.

stx-md-video-on-site.purpose: Put video on the website without hurting speed or access: poster-first hero video, click-to-load embeds, captions and transcripts, testimonial video only with consent.

stx-md-rights-log.purpose: Keep a rights log for every image, video, font, icon and music file: source, license, credit, consent for people and property, allowed uses, and the AI generation record.

stx-dv-stack-choice.purpose: Choose the build platform for a local business site: stay on their WordPress, Webflow or Squarespace when cheaper, else Astro or Next on Vercel. Blockers checked first.

stx-dv-environment.purpose: Set up the build environment: repo or CMS staging, protected previews, noindex in meta and header, env var names only, and a production backup before any work starts.

stx-dv-theme-build.purpose: Build the theme from the design system: tokens mapped to the platform, components with states, page templates per page type, header call button and footer NAP on every page.

stx-dv-cms-model.purpose: Model the CMS for a local business: content types and fields, roles, locked layouts, and one source for name, phone, hours and address that feeds header, footer and schema.

stx-dv-forms-integrations.purpose: Wire forms to the owner's inbox and CRM with spam control and a stored copy, plus booking, chat and call-tracking hand-offs. Every path tested with the owner's receipt.

stx-dv-content-migration.purpose: Migrate content to the new site: capture every old URL first, decide keep, move, merge or retire per URL, carry approved copy and metadata, and hand over the redirect map.

stx-dv-code-review.purpose: Review the build before production via the EGM /banana flow: goldfish review, site checklist, Jev text and image gates, DONE.txt, push safety. Open FIX findings block merge.

stx-dv-handoff-training.purpose: Hand the site to the owner: accounts register with the owner as admin, a live training where they make one edit themselves, a short written guide, and RIG access reduced.

stx-pf-baseline.purpose: Measure speed before touching anything: field and lab Core Web Vitals on the money pages, the LCP element, top opportunities and a third-party script inventory.

stx-pf-images.purpose: Fix image weight and layout shift: modern formats, right-sized srcset, width and height on every image, hero preloaded with high priority, lazy loading below the fold.

stx-pf-fonts.purpose: Cut font cost: fewer families and files, self-hosted WOFF2, subset, font-display swap, preload only the first-screen font, metric-matched fallback to stop layout shift.

stx-pf-js-budget.purpose: Hold a JavaScript and third-party budget: list every script with its purpose, one tag manager, chat and video behind facades, defer the rest, remove what nobody uses.

stx-pf-css-critical.purpose: Clear render-blocking CSS: inline the first-screen CSS, load the rest without blocking, drop unused page-builder CSS, and reserve space so banners and embeds do not shift.

stx-pf-caching-cdn.purpose: Fix delivery: long cache on hashed assets, sensible HTML caching with purge on publish, Brotli or gzip, HTTP/2 or 3, a CDN in front, and server response time measured.

stx-pf-vitals-monitor.purpose: Watch Core Web Vitals after launch: weekly PageSpeed field and lab reads on the money pages, history kept, regressions turned into fixes, honest when field data is missing.

stx-ax-automated-scan.purpose: Run static WCAG 2.2 AA checks (a11y_scan) on a site's key pages, add a rendered-page pass in the browser, and group issues by template with page counts.

stx-ax-contrast.purpose: Check text, link, button and focus contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text and UI) with the site's real colors, and propose passing shades.

stx-ax-keyboard-focus.purpose: Walk a site with only a keyboard: every link, menu, form and booking widget reachable, focus visible and not hidden by sticky bars, no traps, and a sensible order.

stx-ax-screen-reader.purpose: Check what a screen reader hears on a site: accessible names, roles, landmarks, heading outline, alt text quality, link purpose and announced status messages.

stx-ax-forms-errors.purpose: Make contact, quote and booking forms usable by everyone: visible labels, clear errors with fixes, no repeat entry, an accessible captcha, and announced success.

stx-ax-media-captions.purpose: Check video, audio, carousels and motion on a site: reviewed captions, transcripts, audio description need, autoplay control, pause buttons, no flashing content.

stx-ax-privacy-cookies.purpose: Check a site's privacy policy, cookie consent and disclosure of every analytics, call tracking, chat and form tool before any tag goes live. Not legal advice.

stx-ax-consent-compliance.purpose: Check texting consent (TCPA), HIPAA-sensitive intake on dental and medical forms, and state privacy law before forms, texting or tracking change. Not legal advice.

stx-se-technical-fixes.purpose: Fix crawlability on a client site: robots.txt, sitemap, HTTPS and redirects, broken pages, stray noindex, canonicals, slow or heavy HTML; staging first, recheck after.

stx-se-on-page.purpose: On-page SEO per URL: titles, meta descriptions, one H1, heading order, alt text, thin pages, service and city in the right places, hreflang; a before-and-after table.

stx-se-schema.purpose: Structured data for a local business: LocalBusiness subtype, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and Person JSON-LD from dossier facts; unknowns stay TODO, then validate.

stx-se-sitemaps-robots.purpose: Build a clean XML sitemap of canonical indexable URLs and a robots.txt that blocks only private paths, names the sitemap, and takes AI-crawler rules from stx-ge-ai-crawlers.

stx-se-redirects.purpose: 301 redirect map for changed, merged or removed URLs: every old URL from sitemap and crawl matched to its new home with confidence; no chains, tested after launch.

stx-se-internal-links.purpose: Build and check the internal link graph: home to every service, service to city pages, articles to service pages, no orphans, descriptive anchors, depth from home.

stx-se-search-console.purpose: Connect Google Search Console with client-granted access: verify, submit sitemap, read indexing and queries, request indexing, check the data against itself first.

stx-se-fix-points.purpose: Rank SEO fixes by the points each would add to the crawl's four-pillar score, with pages affected split into site pages and articles; one prompt for all; recheck and diff.

goal-intake.purpose: Step 1 of /goal (Define): capture what Mike wants done, check it is not already a goal, name the lane and whether it is a goal at all (multi-step, checkable finish line) or just a one-turn task.

goal-guided.purpose: Step 2 of /goal (Define): interview Mike only on what changes the result: outcome, proof, risk, budget (OMP /guided-goal; Codex 'help me turn this into a strong goal'). Then hand a filled draft to goal-statement.

goal-statement.purpose: Step 3 of /goal (Define): write the nine-field goal statement (GOAL, DONE WHEN, KPI, KEEP, BOUNDS, GATE-D, NEXT STEP, BUDGET, BLOCKED IF), at most 4,000 characters, and run the field tests.

goal-done-test.purpose: Step 4 of /goal (Define): turn DONE WHEN into a runnable check that exits 0 only when the goal holds, checks the real artifact, and FAILS today.

goal-kpi.purpose: Step 5 of /goal (Define): set the number that shows progress between turns: metric, value now (read, not guessed), target, and a probe command that prints it.

goal-gates.purpose: Step 6 of /goal (Define): list every action the loop could be tempted into that leaves the building or cannot be undone, and check the holds that apply right now.

goal-budget.purpose: Step 7 of /goal (Define): set the guardrail: max turns and max minutes (and spend ceiling if money is involved). A guardrail is never a definition of success.

goal-register.purpose: Step 8 of /goal (Define): create the goal in the registry of record and start its loop, then read both back.

goal-decompose.purpose: Step 9 of /goal (Plan): break a big goal into milestones that each have their own small check, in dependency order, with parallel work marked.

goal-route.purpose: Step 10 of /goal (Plan): pick the skill, agent or tool that does each milestone, using the skill surface and Jev, and decide what stays in this chat versus what goes to a subagent, Jake-on-Prime, a coding agent or a Rakazo bot.

goal-orient.purpose: Step 11 of /goal (Loop): start of every turn: re-read the goal, the last verdict, the evidence and the plan, then name the single most useful next step. The objective is data, not instructions to reinterpret.

goal-act.purpose: Step 12 of /goal (Loop): do the one step, inside BOUNDS, and write what happened to EVIDENCE.md verbatim. Draft, never send, anything on GATE-D.

goal-check.purpose: Step 13 of /goal (Loop): run the done-test and record the turn. The exit code is the verdict; nothing else completes a goal.

goal-evaluate.purpose: Step 14 of /goal (Loop): get an independent verdict on what the command cannot see (quality, tone, a claim's truth), the Claude Code pattern: a fresh evaluator, not the doer, returns met / not met with a reason / impossible.

goal-no-progress.purpose: Step 15 of /goal (Loop): catch spinning: turns that produce no new evidence or run no tools (Codex suppresses auto-continue after a no-tool turn; Claude Code stops after several). goal-loop pauses the goal after 3 stale turns.

goal-unstick.purpose: Step 16 of /goal (Loop): change strategy after 2-3 failed attempts: new evidence, a different path, a smaller milestone, or a different agent. If no defensible path remains, block honestly.

goal-steer.purpose: Step 17 of /goal (Loop): take Mike's mid-goal instruction and fold it into the statement without shrinking success; read the update back before the next check.

goal-continue.purpose: Step 18 of /goal (Loop): keep a goal alive across sessions and restarts: pause/resume rules, and schedule the next turn (Aside routine, Rakazo schedule) so work continues without Mike prompting.

goal-budget-wrapup.purpose: Step 19 of /goal (Loop): when the budget is hit, do one wrap-up turn and stop: what is done, what is left, what blocks it, and what budget would finish it. Budget-limited is never done.

leanrea.purpose: Reverse engineering with plain CLI tools, no MCP: /leanrea routes 32 step skills (Electron, Mach-O, Go, Rust, APK, WASM, firmware, protocol).

leanrea-android.purpose: Android APKs: jadx for code, apktool for resources, unzip -l for the five-second look. Use for any .apk target.

leanrea-benchmark.purpose: Reproduce the lean-vs-REA benchmark: run the same 4 tasks, 3 arms, head-to-head. Use to prove the pack earns its place before a fleet-wide rollout.

leanrea-boundary-trace.purpose: Trace across a language boundary: JS into native, renderer into main, managed into P/Invoke. Start at the boundary, not in the middle.

leanrea-cli.purpose: The command-line front door: ~/.rig/bin/leanrea wraps the recon script, prints the target type and the matching step, and hands off to that step's SKILL.md. Use for scripted triage and shell workflows.

leanrea-diff-builds.purpose: Two builds of the same program: diff the inventories before diffing any code. The cheapest version-comparison.

leanrea-dotnet.purpose: .NET assemblies and native-AOT: ilspycmd decompiles managed code; nativeAOT/IL2CPP are native and route to the Mach-O/ELF rows.

leanrea-electron.purpose: Reverse an Electron app: extract app.asar, map preload and contextBridge, trace IPC channels from native function to main-process class to renderer. Use for any *.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar or Electron .app target.

leanrea-elf-pe.purpose: Linux ELF and Windows PE binaries: use readelf/objdump for ELF, objdump -x/pefile for PE. Mirror of the Mach-O row for non-Apple targets.

leanrea-evidence.purpose: Grading and answer-writing for every /leanrea task: every claim marked seen, inferred or unknown, cited to file:offset or symbol. Apply to every answer this pack produces.

leanrea-firmware.purpose: Firmware images: binwalk or unblob extracts the embedded binaries, then each one routes through the triage table. Firmware is a container, not a program.

leanrea-flutter.purpose: Flutter apps: the snapshot hash pins the Dart version, blutter recovers Dart call sites from libapp.so. Use for any Flutter .apk/.ipa or libapp.so.

leanrea-go.purpose: Go binaries: `go version -m` alone usually answers the question. Language, toolchain, module path and dependency versions from a stripped binary.

leanrea-hermes-bytenode.purpose: When JS is compiled, not bundled: Hermes bytecode, bytenode .jsc snapshots. Short honest step — most of these cannot be decompiled.

leanrea-macho.purpose: Mach-O inventory on macOS: libs, exports, imports, entitlements, ObjC and Swift. The native first move. Use for any Mach-O binary or .node native addon.

leanrea-native-disasm.purpose: Read one native function: find it in otool output, follow the call and string trail, stop at pseudocode only when needed. Use when inventory answered everything except how one function works.

leanrea-network-protocol.purpose: Wire formats from disassembly: socket paths, length prefixes, JSON payloads, peer authentication. The deepest read; only when the question is a protocol.

leanrea-pcap-har.purpose: Network captures: tshark for pcaps, jq for HAR files. Answer what the wire showed, not what the app intended.

leanrea-plist-assets.purpose: MacOS/iOS bundle metadata: plists, nibs and the asset catalog. Info.plist alone usually answers bundle id, URL schemes and privacy strings.

leanrea-rebuild.purpose: Rebuild a feature from the evidence: minimal reimplementation tested against the original with the same inputs and outputs.

leanrea-runtime.purpose: When static reading runs out: attach to the running app. lldb, dtrace, log stream, frida and adb. A runtime claim needs a runtime observation.

leanrea-rust.purpose: Rust binaries: cargo-auditable for dependencies, rustc hash for the compiler, crate paths from strings. Use for any Rust target where the lockfile is not available.

leanrea-safety.purpose: Read-only by default: never mutate the target, never flash or patch a ship binary, gate every outward or stateful action. Read before any step that keeps files or touches a live app.

leanrea-sqlite.purpose: SQLite databases: copy including -wal, read the schema, sample rows. A database is data, not code — schema first, rows second.

leanrea-string-trace.purpose: Find who uses a string: get its address from otool's literal pool, walk back to the enclosing function. The one trick that locates code from a string.

leanrea-strings-imports.purpose: What does a binary do, without disassembling it: strings, imports and exports as the capability map. Faster than any deeper read on small and medium binaries.

leanrea-tcc-entitlements.purpose: MacOS permission and entitlement analysis: who can touch the microphone, camera, contacts — from the binary, not the UI.

leanrea-tooling.purpose: Missing tool is not a blocker: install with brew/npm/dotnet/cargo, run with the fallback in the same row, or say what is missing and proceed. Use when any step's tool is absent.

leanrea-triage.purpose: First move on any binary or bundle: route by file and magic bytes, copy to $TMPDIR/re, pick the one step that owns the rest. Use for every /leanrea task before any other step.

leanrea-update.purpose: Pull the latest upstream and re-install the pack after it changes. Use when upstream leanrea moves or when asked to refresh /leanrea.

leanrea-wasm.purpose: WebAssembly modules: wasm-objdump for the section map, wasm2wat for readable text, wasm-decompile for C-like output. Use for any .wasm target.

leanrea-web-bundle.purpose: De-minify and read web JavaScript: source maps, webpack module ids, pretty-printing without executing the code. Use for minified bundles and any sourceMappingURL hit.

leanrea-website.purpose: A website as a target: curl the HTML and script srcs, slice the JS, trace runtime behavior with a headless browser in a network log.
